title: Seiko 5 SNK809 vs Timex Expedition Scout 40mm
summary_winner: The Seiko, if you want a mechanical watch. That is genuinely the only argument for it. The 7S26 movement does not hand-wind and does not hack, it is rated to just 30 m, and at 37 mm it is small by modern standards. The Timex is more accurate, more water resistant at 50 m, has a backlight you can read in the dark, and asks nothing of you. Almost every practical argument favours the Timex. The Seiko is still the one most people should buy first, because a cheap automatic tells you whether you actually like mechanical watches before you spend real money finding out.
